notes.title: December, 22th Update
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 "Continue" button in main menu now works properly, launching last played or newly unlocked mission and restoring player progress. It will work only for missions completed after this patch.
 Fixed message for overkooked food not disappearing
 Fixed a bug when container with frozen samples can go under the landscape
 Fixed a bug when arachnid web puddles could continue dealing damage infinitely
 If main objective on Fluorescent level is finished, harvesting drones cannot be activated anymore


Improvements:

 Added more wandering enemies on Fluorescent level
 Sprint breating starts later
 Fixed a typo in dialogues
